subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Mean Time to Detect
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Mean Time to Detect.

hook.text: A bug was introduced Monday. It was found Friday. Five days of broken code in the codebase. Ouch.

buildup.text: Mean time to detect (MTTD) measures how long a defect exists before someone discovers it.

discovery.text: Shorter MTTD means faster feedback loops—bugs are caught while the developer still remembers the code.

twist.text: MTTD depends on test frequency. Weekly tests find bugs in days. Continuous tests find them in minutes.

climax.text: CI/CD with automated tests shrinks MTTD from days to minutes—transforming how quickly teams respond.

punchline.text: The faster you find it, the cheaper it is to fix.
